# Acme Todo — AI assistant brief

## Mission
Team-collaboration todo manager used by ~30 engineers at Acme. Engineers create and edit
their own todos, share them with teammates, and group them into projects. Replaces the
dispersion of todo lists across personal note apps with a single, audited backlog.

## Stack
- Language / runtime : TypeScript / Node 22 (frontend) ; Java 24 / JVM 24 (backend).
- Frameworks (direct) : Angular 21 (zoneless, signals), Tailwind v4, Spring Boot 4.
- Build : `cd backend && mvn -B verify` ; `cd frontend && npm run build`.
- Tests : `cd backend && mvn -B test` (unit) / `mvn -B verify` (+ ITs via Testcontainers) ; `cd frontend && npm test -- --run --coverage`.

## How to build / test / run
- Build : `make build` (delegates to mvn + npm).
- Test : `make test` (full reactor + Vitest with coverage gate).
- Run dev : `make dev` (Spring Boot on :8080, ng serve on :4200).

## Conventions
- Branch : `feat/<area>-<slug>` ; never push to `main` directly.
- Commit subject : Conventional Commits (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, …).
- Backend : OpenAPI-first ; controllers implement generated interfaces under `backend/openapi/openapi.json`.
- Frontend : signal stores in `frontend/src/app/features/<feature>/<feature>.store.ts` ; no raw HTTP in components.
- All UI text via Transloco — no hard-coded strings.
- DB migrations : Liquibase YAML under `backend/smith-todo-data/src/main/resources/db/changelog/`.

## When to load which spec
- User asks WHAT → read `.smith/FUNCTIONAL_SPECIFICATION.MD`.
- User asks HOW (architecture / modules / persistence) → read `.smith/TECHNICAL_SPECIFICATION.MD`.
- User asks which framework / version / build / test / infra tool → read `.smith/project-config.json` (`project.frameworks` + `project.*_tools`).

## Smith CLI in this repo
- Adapted skills live under `.claude/skills/` (5 angular-* skills + agent-status + mvn + npm).
- Generation report : `.smith/GENERATION_REPORT.MD`.
- Stack state : `.smith/project-config.json` ; Smith state : `.smith/smith-config.json`.
- Visual overview : `.smith/dashboard.html` (re-render via `/smith-dashboard`).
- For Smith-CLI commands (`/smith-*`), run `/smith-help` in Claude Code.

## Tools to prefer
- Maven : run via the `/mvn` skill (Haiku-offload) — keeps the build log out of the parent context.
- npm : run via the `/npm` skill, same reason.
- Sub-agent dispatch + tool calls are auto-tracked in `AGENT_STATUS.MD` (bundle ia-stats).

## Tools to avoid
- `mvn spring-boot:run` from this session — runs forever, blocks the turn. Use `make dev` in a separate terminal.
- `npm run start` / `ng serve` from this session — same reason.
- `git push --force` on `main` or release branches — protected. If needed on a feature branch, ask first.

## Glossary
- Todo : a unit of work owned by one engineer, optionally shared with teammates.
- Project : a named group of todos. Owned by one engineer ; visible to invited members.
- Digest : the Monday-09:00-UTC summary email of a project's open todos.
